trap.label: artigo
trap.wrong: I am writing as constituent and teacher to urge you oppose the bill.
trap.right: I am writing as a constituent and a teacher to urge you to oppose the bill.
trap.why: Português omite o artigo antes de profissão; inglês exige a, e urge + objeto + to.
